title: athyrium filix-femina f. subtripinnatum
intro: Athyrium filix-femina f. subtripinnatum, commonly known as Lady fern, is a variant of the Lady fern species, characterized by its subtripinnate leaves. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an expectorant to relieve respiratory conditions. The health benefits of Lady fern are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, diuretic, and expectorant properties, as well as its ability to stimulate the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium filix-femina f. subtripinnatum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
